prompts.netting: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE separate illustration for a UK vegetable gardening book, on a genuinely transparent background. Images 1 (pea) and 2 (cabbage) are authoritative STYLE references; image 3 (watering illustration) shows how the house style handles soil and practical props. Copy their bold simplified colour planes, lime/forest greens and graphic cream highlights, but NO dark background or halo. Subject: a small rectangular soil bed with five young green brassica plants, enclosed on top and ALL FOUR SIDES with fine pale grey-green insect-proof mesh. Three-quarter slightly elevated view. SIX slim bamboo canes, three down each long side, pushed firmly into soil, each capped by an inverted intact green glass beer bottle (bottle mouth down over cane, smooth broad bottle base upwards). Fine mesh rests on the smooth bottle bases, with clearly visible air space above the plants. Bottles and canes must remain discernible through mesh. No wooden bed walls. The cover reaches the ground continuously all around. Long low wooden battens weigh the hems along all four edges, with a few bricks on them; NO open entrance, no exposed gaps, no dangling loops. Cover tension is gentle, no stretched giant holes; small subtle grid suggests fine mesh, not chunky fence netting. Strong clear readable silhouette, modest perspective, no background landscape, no people, no lettering, no labels, no arrows, no cropped tips. Wide landscape composition with the complete covered bed inside frame and generous transparent margin. Instructional geometry is more important than decorative detail. Avoid photorealistic texture or dense veining. This will print about 116mm wide x 49mm high.

prompts.beans-v1: Create ONE clear educational illustration, genuinely transparent background, for a British vegetable gardening book. prompts.tomatoes-v1: Create ONE clear educational illustration on a genuinely transparent background for a British gardening book. Match approved supplied house style: bold simplified forest/lime-green leaf planes, cream highlights, warm earthy soil and bamboo, crisp shapes, no photographic texture or background halo. Show a tall cylindrical tomato cage made from stiff grey-green welded wire mesh, with clearly visible large square openings. Three-quarter view, full structure from top to ground. A modestly leafy cordon tomato plant grows within, its central stem supported by a single sturdy vertical bamboo cane with two loose green figure-eight stem ties; show only a couple orange-red tomatoes, enough space to inspect structure. The wire cylinder seam is clipped together. Two visible U-shaped metal pegs anchor the bottom of the cage firmly into a small patch of soil. A diagonal bamboo brace runs from near the upper cage edge out to the ground, tied securely at its top, acting as a buttress against wind; all parts physically connected. Wire cage is tall and roughly cylindrical, not a conical commercial three-ring frame. No pots, no wooden raised bed, no scenery, no person. Whole cage, brace and pegs inside frame with transparent margin. Print about66mm wide x43mm high, simplified large readable details. No text, arrows, labels or measurements.
